close_reason: CrlChecker and OcspChecker both override check_revocation_against_anchor; 4+6 new tests
description: RevocationChecker::check_revocation_against_anchor has a default Ok(()) impl. Neither CrlChecker nor OcspChecker override it, so the certificate directly issued by the trust anchor is silently skipped in all shipped implementations. This is a silent correctness hole — no compile error, no runtime warning.
title: pkix-revocation: check_revocation_against_anchor not overridden in CrlChecker or OcspChecker
